summary: Retain known sale windows during variant enrichment, represent every comparison input within bounded output, and expose partial failures in diagnostics.
reason: Missing variant fields are unobserved replacements, not evidence that a displayed deadline disappeared. A combined comparison cap must not hide an entire successful input; incomplete reads must remain visible in both metadata and stderr.
validated_outcome: Regression cases cover missing/invalid/one-sided date enrichment, uneven session groups, undersized comparison limits and JSON/stderr partial diagnostics.
